title: Radiators and Silence
author: Mara Hartwell
blurb: Ulyana Almeida, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
